name: Jhaveri Credits and Capital Limited
about: Jhaveri Credits and Capital Limited engages in the investment and trading of solar equipment and related products business in India. The company offers inverters, cables and other electronic accessories as well as trading, exports, and imports solar panels. It also engages in the investment in shares, stock and securities etc. Jhaveri Credits and Capital was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
